customManagers.description: Pick up the three pinned MongoDB test image tags in tests/MongoDbTestImages.cs.
matchStrings: renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>.*?) depName=(?<depName>.*?) packageName=(?<packageName>.*?) versioning=(?<versioning>.*?)\s*\n\s*public const String \w+ = "mongo:(?<currentValue>.*?)";

customManagers.description: Pick up the latest tested MongoDB.Driver version that the latest-driver CI job tests against. The nuget manager resolves MSBuild properties only from the first PropertyGroup of a file, so it skips this pin, which is in a later one. The pin sets versioning=semver, because the nuget versioning reads a bare version as a minimum and would propose no update. The src dependency minimums rule matches the nuget manager only, so minor and patch updates of this pin open pull requests directly. Major updates wait for Dependency Dashboard approval through the repo-baseline preset.

packageRules.description: Hold the minimum-supported Mongo test image to the 7.0.x line.
Hold the primary Mongo test image to the 8.0.x line.
Hold the dependency minimums of the src/ packages (see Directory.Packages.props) for Dependency Dashboard approval. Vulnerability fixes still open pull requests.

Update the test dependencies of the reference verifier together in one pull request, major versions included. --require-hashes installs them as one pinned set, and they are test-only, so majors need no Dependency Dashboard approval.
